relevance_note: Single case report of an infant with genetically confirmed ATS: "Whole-exome sequencing performed after surgery confirmed a homozygous pathogenic SLC2A10 variant".
method_note: Read the whole paper; JSON built with a short Python script in scratch, all values from manual reading; spans checked verbatim by script. Three rows: the index patient ('patient'); one affected relative described individually ('relative of patient'; relation not specified beyond 'relative', not tested, so no variant row; 'no known cardiovascular symptoms before surgery' not recorded as an exclusion because it is hedged); and the previously published 13-year-old from the only prior anesthetic ATS case report, attributed to reference (4) from the paragraph's citation ('ref (4) patient'; no variant printed). The other 'multiple relatives with congenital diaphragmatic hernia, paraesophageal hernia, and tortuous pulmonary arteries' are described only as a group and get no rows. No SLC2A10 variant description is printed (variant_original_string 'not reported'). Age 3 months is the age at presentation/surgery; no age is given for the later follow-up. 'normal aortic root' recorded as excluded aortic root dilatation (D-27); 'normal biventricular function' as excluded ventricular dysfunction (does not address hypertrophy). Vital status 'alive' taken from the follow-up statement of satisfactory recovery. Intraoperative events (no hemodynamic instability, arrhythmias, hypoxemia) not recorded as phenotypes. The first-author surname is taken from the header 'Alzayer Zainab Abdulaziz'; name order is not certain. Discussion statement that 'several of these features were present' (micrognathia, high-arched palate, midface retrusion) does not say which, so midface retrusion is not recorded. No contradictions found.

study_type.span: Anesthetic management of an infant with arterial tortuosity syndrome undergoing combined laparoscopic procedures: a case report

vital_status.span: Follow-up in the genetics and endocrinology clinics showed satisfactory recovery and appropriate weight gain.

treatment_summary.value: combined laparoscopic repair of a Morgagni diaphragmatic hernia and a para-esophageal hiatal hernia under general anesthesia; chest physiotherapy for postoperative atelectasis; feeding regimen adjustment and octreotide therapy for postoperative hypoglycemia
